run_distributed_kmeans: run distributed k-means clustering on GPU with kmeans++ init and checkpointing support
run_distributed_kmeans_plusplus_init: run distributed kmeans++ initialization to select initial centroids across multiple GPUs
run_distributed_assign_clusters: run distributed cluster assignment by assigning data points to nearest centroids on GPU
run_distributed_compute_centroids: run distributed centroid computation by averaging data points assigned to each cluster
run_distributed_sort_cluster_by_distance: run distributed sorting of cluster points by distance from their centroid with checkpointing
